{{Quote|They're banking toward a set of ruins&mdash;the colony, I guess.|[[Kell Tainer]], to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SC" />}}
A '''colony''' affiliated with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] existed on [[Selcaron]],<ref name="DoaE1" /> one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Selaggis VI]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Selcaron was [[Attack on Selcaron|attacked]] by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], who used his [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]], the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], to obliterate the colony.<ref name="SC" />
